# Vendor Dependencies

This directory contains cached copies of external dependencies to avoid relying on third-party CDNs.

## Material Design Lite

**Version:** 1.3.0  
**License:** Apache License 2.0  
**Copyright:** 2015 Google, Inc.  
**Source:** https://github.com/google/material-design-lite  
**Downloaded from:** https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/material-design-lite/1.3.0/

Material Design Lite is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. The license and copyright notices are preserved in the file headers.

### Files:
- `material.min.js` - Core JavaScript library
- `material.*.min.css` - Color scheme stylesheets

To update these dependencies, run: `bash bin/cache_dependencies.sh`
